title: Learning-Based Surrogate Method for Stochastic Optimization under Decision-Dependent Uncertainty with Adaptive Random Designs
abstract: arXiv:2505.07298v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study stochastic programs in which the latent decision-dependent uncertainty is described via a nonparametric regression model. The major challenge is that, without convexity assumptions on either the cost function or the regression model, the resulting objective is both nonconvex and nonsmooth, and its first-order information is unavailable due to the unknown decision-dependent distribution. To address this issue, we construct a learning-based surrogate model that integrates simulation and statistical learning by embedding Jacobian estimates of the regression function, which are updated iteratively and interactively during the optimization procedure. We develop an adaptive random design that concentrates design points around the current iterate for Jacobian estimation and we show that the mean squared error of Jacobian estimates achieves a dimension-independent convergence rate. translated_title: 基于学习的代理方法用于具有自适应随机设计的决策依赖不确定性随机优化
translated_abstract: 我们研究了一类随机规划问题，其中潜在的决策依赖不确定性通过非参数回归模型来描述。主要挑战在于，在不对成本函数或回归模型做凸性假设的情况下，所得到的目标函数既是非凸的又是非光滑的，并且由于决策依赖分布未知，其一阶信息无法获得。为解决这一问题，我们构建了一个基于学习的代理模型，该模型通过嵌入回归函数的雅可比估计来集成仿真与统计学习，这些雅可比估计在优化过程中被迭代地、交互式地更新。我们开发了一种自适应随机设计，将设计点集中于当前迭代点附近以进行雅可比估计，并证明了雅可比估计的均方误差实现了与维度无关的收敛速度。在此基础上，我们提出了基于学习的……
tldr: 提出了一种基于学习的代理模型方法，通过嵌入迭代更新的雅可比估计与自适应随机设计，解决了决策依赖不确定性下无凸性假设的非凸非光滑随机优化问题，并实现了雅可比估计均方误差与维度无关的收敛速度。
en_tdlr: Proposes a learning-based surrogate method that embeds iteratively updated Jacobian estimates with adaptive random designs to solve nonconvex, nonsmooth stochastic optimization under decision-dependent uncertainty, achieving dimension-independent convergence rates for Jacobian estimation.
